findings.message: Distinguish stale new verification-delivery admission from an already-admitted/in-flight or unknown delivery. Correction cannot recall mail; old challenge authority must fail, with IF-BOOK-03 reconciliation before safe resend.
Narrow the replacement fence to calendar/meeting booking intent so verification-delivery uncertainty does not impose a blanket post-email correction lock.

limits: No wire/state/numeric/email/timing/privacy/mechanism selection, schema or application implementation, runtime proof or integrated acceptance.
